### Summary of Changes

1. **API & CRD Schema** ([`traffic_policy_types.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go), [`zz_generated.deepcopy.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/zz_generated.deepcopy.go), [`gateway.kgateway.dev_trafficpolicies.yaml`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/install/helm/kgateway-crds/templates/gateway.kgateway.dev_trafficpolicies.yaml)):
   - Added `ConsistentHash` (`spec.consistentHash`) to [`TrafficPolicySpec`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L47-L157) along with [`ConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L161-L185), [`ConsistentHashHeader`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L188-L201), [`ConsistentHashRegexRewrite`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L204-L213), [`ConsistentHashCookie`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L216-L238), [`ConsistentHashCookieAttribute`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L241-L250), [`ConsistentHashQueryParameter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L253-L263), [`ConsistentHashFilterState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L266-L276), and [`ConsistentHashSourceIP`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L279-L283).
   - Added CEL `XValidation` ensuring no other fields may be set when `disable` is `true`, and regenerated CRDs and deepcopy methods via `make go-generate-apis`.

2. **TrafficPolicy Plugin IR, Translation, and Merging** ([`consistent_hash.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go), [`traffic_policy_plugin.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/traffic_policy_plugin.go), [`constructor.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/constructor.go), [`merge.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go)):
   - Implemented [`constructConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L112-L261) to build `RouteAction_HashPolicy` entries in canonical type order (`headers`, `cookies`, `queryParameters`, `filterState`, `sourceIp`), defaulting to a single `sourceIp` hash policy (`terminal=false`) when no sub-fields are specified, enforcing `disable: true` exclusivity, deduplicating entries by key (case-insensitive for `headerName` while preserving first occurrence casing), applying `regexRewrite`, and parsing cookie `ttl` as either Go duration strings or plain integer seconds.
   - Implemented [`mergeConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go#L627-L671) and [`mergeConsistentHashIR`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L266-L343) to union array fields with higher-priority entries first, deduplicate by key, retain the higher-priority policy's `sourceIp` scalar even when unset, re-sort into canonical type order, suppress inherited hash policies when `disable: true`, and record `"consistentHash"` in `merge.TrafficPolicy.gateway.kgateway.dev` metadata.
   - Implemented [`applyConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L346-L369) and wired it into [`handlePerRoutePolicies`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/traffic_policy_plugin.go#L632-L674).

3. **Tests** ([`consistent_hash_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash_test.go), [`gateway_translator_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/pkg/kgateway/translator/gateway/gateway_translator_test.go), [`consistent-hash.yaml`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-vj6s999f/pkg/kgateway/translator/gateway/testutils/inputs/traffic-policy/consistent-hash.yaml)):
   - Added unit tests and gateway translator golden tests covering all `consistentHash` features and merge behaviors.
